metadata.notes: Audit-and-replace of auto-seeded placeholder picks for all 30 Karnataka destinations (114 picks). COMPLETE. KSTDC Hotel Mayura network and Jungle Lodges & Resorts (JLR) used as authoritative government anchors. Chalukya temple villages (Aihole, Pattadakal) and Hoysala/Jain villages (Halebidu, Shravanabelagola) treated as honest-scarcity day-trips off Badami/Hassan bases; tiger-reserve destinations anchored on JLR lodges + verified private resorts; pilgrim towns (Dharmasthala, Kukke Subramanya) anchored on official temple-trust devasthana guest houses. Major catches: Taj Bekal mislabelled for Mangalore (actually Bekal, KERALA — cross-state), Hotel Mayura Chalukya mislabelled for Chitradurga (actually Badami ~280 km — cross-dest), Jungle Lodges Bandipur used for Mysore x-factor (cross-dest ~80 km), Windflower Coorg used for Bengaluru x-factor (cross-dest ~250 km), 'The Lalit Mahal Palace' Mysore (real property is Lalitha Mahal Palace, a government heritage hotel — Lalit is a different chain), 'Jagannath Palace Heritage Hotel' Bijapur (ghost), 'Hotel Mayura Bahmani' Bidar (no KSTDC Bidar property exists), Aihole/Pattadakal/Halebidu/Shravanabelagola heritage-village ghosts, plus numerous generic-named homestay/farmstay ghosts (Casa Coorg, Surathkal Casa Del Mar, RNS Golf Resort, Atmaveda Riverside, Rasa Kendra, etc.) and one RNS Residency double-listing in Murudeshwar.

existing.name: Aihole Heritage Resort
existing.issue: No verifiable hotel/resort of this name exists in Aihole — a small Chalukya temple village (Bagalkot district) with no tier-1/2 accommodation. Ghost property. Aihole is a day-trip from Badami (~35 km), where the real hotels are.

existing.name: Badami Court Homestay
existing.issue: No 'Badami Court Homestay' exists — the real property is Hotel Badami Court, a 4-star hotel in Badami town, not a homestay and not in Aihole. Aihole has no hotels; re-anchor to the KSTDC government hotel in Badami, the standard base for the Chalukya triangle.

replacement.name: KSTDC Hotel Mayura Chalukya Badami
replacement.tagline: The Karnataka State Tourism government hotel in Badami — plain AC and non-AC rooms in a garden compound with a restaurant, ~35 km from Aihole. The dependable budget base for the Badami-Aihole-Pattadakal circuit.
replacement.address: Ramdurg Road, PWD Compound, Badami 587201, Bagalkot District, Karnataka

existing.name: Aihole Tourist Home
existing.issue: No verifiable property of this name. Aihole village has no tier-1/2 accommodation; all sources confirm visitors stay in Badami (~35 km). Honest scarcity.

existing.name: Banashankari Temple Eco-Camp (seasonal)
existing.issue: No verifiable eco-camp at Banashankari (the temple is near Badami, not Aihole, and there is no operating camp). Fabricated/ghost. No x-factor stay exists for Aihole.

existing.name: Badami Court Resort
existing.issue: Slightly mislabelled — the real property is Hotel Badami Court (a hotel, a unit of Shreejit Resorts), not 'Badami Court Resort'. For the experience slot the more resort-like property is Sterling Banashree Badami, a 4-star 10-acre garden resort with a pool.

replacement.name: Sterling Banashree Badami
replacement.tagline: A 4-star Sterling Holidays resort across 10 acres of garden with an outdoor pool — the most resort-like stay in the Chalukya belt and gateway to the Badami-Pattadakal-Aihole monuments.
replacement.address: Yaragoppa S.B, Badami 587201, Bagalkot District, Karnataka

existing.name: Hotel Rajsangam
existing.issue: The real property is Hotel Rajsangam International, which exists in Badami, but for a cleaner verified value anchor the standard choice is Clarks Inn Badami — a branded 3-star on the main road near the cave temples with consistent quality.

replacement.name: Clarks Inn Badami
replacement.tagline: A branded 3-star Clarks Inn on Badami Main Road near the cave temples and Agastya Lake — clean, consistent rooms with a restaurant and free parking. The dependable value base for the Chalukya triangle.
replacement.address: #1755, Veerapulakeshi Circle, Badami Main Road, Badami 587201, Karnataka

existing.name: Banashankari Eco-Camp (seasonal)
existing.issue: No verifiable eco-camp operates at Banashankari near Badami. Fabricated/ghost. Badami has no genuine x-factor camp or glamping property.

existing.name: Badami Palace View

replacement.name: KSTDC Hotel Mayura Chalukya Badami

existing.name: Rajakal Riverside Resort

replacement.name: KSTDC Hotel Mayura Chalukya Badami

existing.name: Badami Caves Farmstay (Nearby partner)

replacement.name: Hotel Mayura Bidar

existing.name: Nidhi Farm Stay

replacement.name: SDK Residency, Shravanabelagola
replacement.tagline: A simple residency hotel close to the Shravanabelagola town centre — a non-dharamshala budget option for travellers who want a regular hotel room near the Gommateshwara monolith.

existing.name: Hoysala Village Resort Hassan
existing.issue: Cross-dest — Hoysala Village Resort is in Hassan town (~50 km from Shravanabelagola). It is a real resort but is firmly a Hassan-base property; using it as Shravanabelagola's experience pick is a cross-dest mislabel. No tier-1/2 resort exists at or near Shravanabelagola; the experience slot is honest scarcity, but a closer real upscale option is the KSTDC route via Hassan — re-anchored to the genuine in-town pilgrim flagship instead.
